title: Ending soon: All-time high Marriott card bonus offers worth up to 200,000 points
raw_text:
Two Marriott credit cards have increased welcome bonuses set to expire on May 13, 2026. If your summer vacation budget is straining under inflated gas prices and airfare, these deals may provide relief.
Right now, you can unlock all-time high welcome bonuses for the following cards:
- Marriott Bonvoy Bevy® American Express® Card: Earn 175,000 bonus points after spending $5,000 in purchases within the first six months of card membership
- Marriott Bonvoy Brilliant® American Express® Card: Earn 200,000 bonus points after spending $6,000 in purchases within the first six months of card membership
The Marriott Bonvoy Business® American Express® Card also has an astounding offer of up to five Free Night Awards, but there is no official expiration date for that deal.
The Marriott Bonvoy Bevy® American Express® Card is a mid-tier hotel card that provides elite status and the opportunity to earn a Free Night Award each year.
- 15 Elite Night Credits every year
- Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy® Gold Elite Status
- Bonus points on paid stays booked directly with Marriott
- No statement credits to offset the high annual fee
- Free Night Award has a high spending requirement

Amex typically limits you to earning a welcome bonus once per card per lifetime, so it's even more advantageous to apply for an American Express credit card when the intro bonus is elevated. Marriott Bonvoy credit cards also have additional (convoluted) eligibility guidelines since they are issued by both Chase and Amex.
Since these are the largest bonuses we've seen for the Marriott Bonvoy Bevy and Marriott Bonvoy Brilliant, there's no better time to consider these cards. Plus, both cards provide a full six months to meet the minimum spending requirement, which makes them more accessible for anyone who isn't a big spender.
Marriott has dynamic award prices, which means you'll need to look up the exact hotel and dates to know how many points you need for a trip. The downside of this is that a top-tier hotel during peak season can cost over 100,000 points a night, so you may only get one or two nights from these bonuses (albeit at an expensive property). There's also an upside to dynamic prices, because you can stretch your points further if your travel dates are flexible. This is especially true if you can take advantage of deals, such as Stay for 5, Pay for 4 or PointSavers.
Stay for 5, Pay for 4 allows you to book a five-night stay with points and only pay for four nights. You'll receive the discount as long as a Standard Room is available for points bookings, and you can earn more than one free night on the same reservation. For example, a ten-night stay would receive a two-night discount, etc. (the two cheapest nights would be free).
PointSavers are discounted award nights. While there is no master list of PointSavers hotels or dates, they are clearly denoted in Marriott's award night search results. You can stack these discounted nights with the Stay for 5, Pay for 4 deal for even more savings.
The Marriott Bonvoy Business has a two-tiered welcome offer. You can earn three Free Night Awards after spending $6,000 in purchases and two more Free Night Awards after spending an additional $3,000 in purchases ($9,000 in total) on the card in the first six months of card membership.
Each of these free nights is valid for nights costing up to 50,000 points, and you can top off each award with up to 25,000 points. That makes this bonus potentially the most valuable. However, it also has additional restrictions.
Free Night Awards don't qualify for the Stay for 5, Pay for 4 promo, and they expire 12 months after they are issued. So if you don't have firm plans to stay at a property where you can use your free nights, one of the more flexible points-only bonuses may be better for you.
The Marriott Bonvoy Business® American Express® Card gives business owners the opportunity to earn up to two free night awards every year and bonus points on common business expenses.
- Free Night Award every year you keep the card
- Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy® Gold Elite Status
- 15 Elite Night Credits every year
- Annual fee is over $100
- Additional Free Night Award has a high spending requirement
Highlights shown here are provided by the issuer and have not been reviewed by CNBC Select's editorial staff.

Each Free Night Award has a redemption level up to 50,000 Marriott Bonvoy® points, for a total potential value of up to 250,000 points, at hotels participating in Marriott Bonvoy®. Certain hotels have resort fees. Terms apply.

- 6x points on each dollar of eligible purchases at hotels participating in the Marriott Bonvoy® program.
- 4x points for purchases made at restaurants worldwide, at U.S. gas stations, on wireless telephone services purchased directly from U.S. service providers and on U.S. purchases for shipping.
- 2x points on all other eligible purchases.
- Receive 1 Free Night Award every year after your Card renewal month. Plus, earn an additional Free Night Award after you spend $60K in purchases on your Card in a calendar year. Award can be used for one night (redemption level at or under 35,000 points) at hotels participating in Marriott Bonvoy®. Certain hotels have resort fees.
- Enjoy Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy® Gold Elite Status with your Marriott Bonvoy Business® American Express® Card.
- Terms apply.
